summary:
Configured the applet to run on port 4000 with port 3000 dual compatibility.
- Set Winter (Frost & Snow) as the active default seasonal theme across the entire application and 3D canvas (falling snow particle physics, glacial sky/cyan aura).
- Integrated the user's official 3D glowing 'BUKKUZ SMP' crystal logo across Navbar, Hero section, Footer, Favicon, and OpenGraph social metadata.
- Removed the 30-Day Uptime Monitor (status monitor) section from the Server Dashboard.
- Removed port 8080 restrictions to ensure zero interference with Pterodactyl Wings game node daemon.
